title: The Approximation Ratio of $k$-means++ Is $2\ln k+O(1)$
abstract: arXiv:2611.14573v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Given a finite set of points in Euclidean space, $k$-means clustering seeks $k$ centers that minimize the sum of squared distances from each point to its nearest center. The $k$-means++ algorithm chooses its first center uniformly at random from the data points and each subsequent center with probability proportional to its squared distance from the nearest center already chosen. Let $R_k$ be the worst-case ratio between the expected cost of the $k$ seeds chosen by $k$-means++ and the optimal $k$-means cost. In their seminal paper introducing $k$-means++, Arthur and Vassilvitskii (SODA 2007) showed that $2\ln k\le R_k\le8(\ln k+2)$, and Makarychev, Reddy and Shan (NeurIPS 2020) improved the upper bound to $5(\ln k+2)$. translated_title: k-means++ 算法的近似比为 $2\ln k+O(1)$
translated_abstract: 给定欧几里得空间中的一个有限点集，k-均值聚类旨在寻找 k 个中心，使得每个点到其最近中心的距离平方和最小。k-means++ 算法从数据点中均匀随机地选取第一个中心，随后每个新中心被选中的概率与其到已选最近中心的距离平方成正比。设 $R_k$ 为 k-means++ 所选 k 个种子的期望代价与最优 k-均值代价之间的最坏情况比值。在引入 k-means++ 的开创性论文中，Arthur 和 Vassilvitskii（SODA 2007）证明了 $2\ln k\le R_k\le 8(\ln k+2)$，随后 Makarychev、Reddy 和 Shan（NeurIPS 2020）将上界改进为 $5(\ln k+2)$。我们证明 $R_k=2\ln k+O(1)$；更精确地说，当 $k\ge2$ 时，$2H_{k-1}+2\le R_k\le 2H_{k-2}+5$，其中 $H_j$ 为第 $j$ 个调和数，因此上下界之差小于 3。我们还确定了 $R_2=5$……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文精确刻画了 k-means++ 算法的最坏情况近似比，证明 $R_k=2\ln k+O(1)$（即 $2H_{k-1}+2\le R_k\le 2H_{k-2}+5$，上下界相差不到 3），并确定 $R_2=5$，基本解决了这一十余年悬而未决的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper precisely pins down the worst-case approximation ratio of the k-means++ algorithm, proving $R_k=2\ln k+O(1)$ via the tight bounds $2H_{k-1}+2\le R_k\le 2H_{k-2}+5$ (differing by less than 3) and establishing $R_2=5$, essentially resolving a long-standing open question.
